payload.title: Public submit-a-link
payload.description:
Signed-in readers submit a link to a publication. Decision (2026-10-21): submissions are public immediately; moderation (epic below, optional) acts after the fact unless a publication turns pre-moderation on. Entity extraction runs asynchronously on a worker, never in the request.

Parent initiative: PPY-77bb3b (milestones 6 and 7). Depends on: reader accounts epic (sibling). Related: moderation epic (sibling), Biblicus typed-entity extractor blbs-81ec10 (extraction backend), existing reference intake (editor-only today). Pilot: Shipped.

Children: submit mutation and pending record; asynchronous extraction and entity confirm step; duplicate check, spam and abuse limits; submit form component.
Definition of Done: a signed-in reader on a pilot site can submit a link, sees it publicly as pending at once, and the extraction result arrives afterwards without blocking the submit.
